note: The all-purpose reaction to anything impressive or shocking. You will hear it constantly.
A short gasp of surprise or disbelief. Typed constantly in messages.
Honey is used as a prefix meaning "great". The opposite is 노잼.

example.en: This drama is so much fun.

note: The English "no" glued to 재미. Blunt but not rude.
Someone who is naturally in the middle of things. The opposite is 아싸, an outsider.

example.en: She is totally the social type.

note: An abbreviation of 갑자기 분위기 싸해짐. Used when a joke lands badly.
English "king" as an intensifier stuck onto 열받다. Playful rather than serious anger.
A shortening of the English phrase. Handy when there is no single answer.
Very common online and often written JMT. The first syllable comes from a vulgar word, so keep it away from work and older people. 정말 맛있어요 is the safe version.

lit: what are you going to do + TV
note: A teen taunt with no real meaning attached to the TV part. Fine as a joke between friends, dismissive to anyone else.
